text: Margo corners The Phantom in the Grand Gallery, but instead of a dramatic reveal of her brother, the figure turns to face her with a calm, knowing smile. He is not her sibling, but a master forger who has been one step ahead of her all along. As Margo reaches for her handcuffs, the thief gestures to the empty pedestal where the stolen masterpiece once stood. "You were looking for a person, Detective," he says, "but the real theft was the illusion itself." He vanishes into the shadows, leaving behind only a single, perfectly crafted replica of the painting. Margo realizes the game is far from over, and the hunt continues. The bird known for its ability to repeat what you say is the parrot.
